title: 第29课 · 我也喜欢游泳
subtitle: Lesson 29 — 我也喜欢游泳 · I also like swimming

items.py: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?
items.en: What kind of sports do you like?

items.zh: 爬山、滑冰、游泳，我都喜欢。
items.py: Pá shān, huá bīng, yóu yǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
items.en: Mountaineering, skating and swimming — I like them all.

items.py: Nǐ yóu yǒng yóu de hǎo bu hǎo?

items.zh: 我游得不好，没有你游得好。
items.py: Wǒ yóu de bù hǎo, méiyǒu nǐ yóu de hǎo.
items.en: I can't swim well. I can't swim as well as you.

items.py: Shéi gēn shéi bǐsài?
items.en: Which teams are playing? / Who competes with whom?

items.py: Běijīng Duì duì Guǎngdōng Duì.
items.en: The Beijing Team plays against the Guangdong Team.

items.zh: 我在写毛笔字，没画画儿。
items.py: Wǒ zài xiě máobǐzì, méi huà huàr.
items.en: I'm writing with a brush, not drawing.

items.py: Wǒ xiǎng xiūxi yīhuìr.
items.en: I want to have a rest.

items.py: Liú Jīng: Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yùndòng?
items.en: Liu Jing: What sports do you like?

items.zh: 大卫：爬山、滑冰、游泳，我都喜欢，你呢？
items.py: Dàwèi: Pá shān, huá bīng, yóu yǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuan, nǐ ne?
items.en: David: Climbing, skating, swimming — I like them all. You?

items.zh: 刘京：我常常踢足球、打篮球，也喜欢游泳。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒ chángcháng tī zúqiú, dǎ lánqiú, yě xǐhuan yóu yǒng.
items.en: Liu Jing: I often play soccer and basketball, and also like swimming.

items.py: Dàwèi: Nǐ yóu de hǎo bu hǎo?

items.zh: 刘京：我游得不好，没有你游得好。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Wǒ yóu de bù hǎo, méiyǒu nǐ yóu de hǎo.
items.en: Liu Jing: Not well, not as well as you.

items.zh: 明天有足球比赛，你看吗？
items.py: Míngtiān yǒu zúqiú bǐsài, nǐ kàn ma?
items.en: There's a soccer match tomorrow, will you watch?

items.py: Dàwèi: Shéi gēn shéi bǐsài?
Liú Jīng: Běijīng Duì duì Guǎngdōng Duì.

items.zh: 大卫：那一定很有意思。我很想看，票一定很难买吧？
items.py: Dàwèi: Nà yīdìng hěn yǒu yìsi. Wǒ hěn xiǎng kàn, piào yīdìng hěn nán mǎi ba?
items.en: David: That must be exciting. I'd love to watch — tickets must be hard to get, right?

items.zh: 刘京：现在去买，可能买得到。
items.py: Liú Jīng: Xiànzài qù mǎi, kěnéng mǎi de dào.
items.en: Liu Jing: If we go now, we might still get them.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ zài huà huàr ma?

items.zh: 大卫：在写毛笔字，没画画儿。
items.py: Dàwèi: Zài xiě máobǐzì, méi huà huàr.
items.en: David: I'm writing with a brush, not drawing.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nǐ xiě de zhēn búcuò!

items.zh: 大卫：练了两个星期了。我没有和子写得好。
items.py: Dàwèi: Liàn le liǎng ge xīngqī le. Wǒ méiyǒu Hézǐ xiě de hǎo.
items.en: David: I've been practising for two weeks. I'm not as good as Hezi.

items.zh: 玛丽：我也很喜欢写毛笔字，可是一点儿也不会。
items.py: Mǎlì: Wǒ yě hěn xǐhuan xiě máobǐzì, kěshì yīdiǎnr yě bú huì.
items.en: Mary: I also love brush writing, but I can't at all.

items.zh: 大卫：没关系，你想学，王老师可以教你。
items.py: Dàwèi: Méi guānxi, nǐ xiǎng xué, Wáng lǎoshī kěyǐ jiāo nǐ.
items.en: David: No problem, if you want to learn, Teacher Wang can teach you.

items.py: Mǎlì: Nà tài hǎo le!

items.zh: 大卫：写累了，我想休息一会儿。
items.py: Dàwèi: Xiě lèi le, wǒ xiǎng xiūxi yīhuìr.
items.en: David: I'm tired from writing, I want to rest a bit.

items.py: Mǎlì: Zǒu, chū qù sànsàn bù ba.
items.en: Mary: Let's go for a walk.

Nǐ yǒu tā gāo ma?
items.en: Are you as tall as him?

items.zh: 那棵树有五层楼那么高。
items.py: Nà kē shù yǒu wǔ céng lóu nàme gāo.
items.en: That tree is as tall as a five-story building.

items.py: Guǎngzhōu méiyǒu Běijīng lěng.
items.en: Guangzhou is not as cold as Beijing.

items.py: Wǒ méiyǒu nǐ yóu de hǎo.
items.en: I can't swim as well as you.

items.py: Wǒ méiyǒu Hézǐ xiě de hǎo.
items.en: I don't write as well as Hezi.

Wǒ jiāo le liǎng ge xīngqī le.
items.en: I've been teaching for two weeks.

items.zh: 玛丽病了两天，没来上课。
items.py: Mǎlì bìng le liǎng tiān, méi lái shàng kè.
items.en: Mary was sick for two days and didn't come to class.

items.py: Fùqin zǒu le yī kèzhōng le.
items.en: Father left a quarter of an hour ago.

Nǐ pǎobù pǎo de kuài bu kuài?
Nǐ dǎ wǎngqiú dǎ de hǎo bu hǎo?

items.zh: 你洗衣服洗得干净不干净？
items.py: Nǐ xǐ yīfu xǐ de gānjìng bu gānjìng?

items.zh: 你回答问题回答得对不对？
items.py: Nǐ huídá wèntí huídá de duì bu duì?
Máobǐzì yīdìng hěn nán xiě ba?
items.en: Brush calligraphy must be hard to write, right?

items.py: Guǎngdōng huà yīdìng hěn nán dǒng ba?
items.en: Cantonese must be hard to understand, right?

items.py: Zhōngguó huà yīdìng hěn nán huà ba?
items.en: Chinese painting must be hard, right?

items.py: Hànyǔ yīdìng hěn nán xué ba?
items.en: Chinese must be hard to learn, right?

items.en: I want to rest for a while.

items.en: I want to sit for a while.

items.py: Wǒ xiǎng shuì yīhuìr.
items.en: I want to sleep for a while.

items.py: Wǒ xiǎng zhàn yīhuìr.
items.en: I want to stand for a while.

items.py: Wǒ xiǎng tǎng yīhuìr.
items.en: I want to lie down for a while.

items.zh: 放假的时候，他常去旅行。
items.py: Fàng jià de shíhou, tā cháng qù lǚxíng.
items.en: During holidays, he often goes travelling.

items.zh: 他每天早上打太极拳，晚饭后散步。
items.py: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang dǎ tàijíquán, wǎnfàn hòu sànbù.
items.en: Every morning he does taijiquan, and takes a walk after dinner.

items.py: Zāogāo, wǒ de yàoshi diū le.
items.en: Oh no, I've lost my keys.

items.py: Hānsī yǒu hěn duō àihào.
Tā xǐhuan yùndòng.
Dōngtiān huá bīng, xiàtiān yóu yǒng.
items.en: He ice skates in winter and swims in summer.

items.zh: 到中国以后，他还学会了打太极拳。
items.py: Dào Zhōngguó yǐhòu, tā hái xuéhuì le dǎ tàijíquán.
items.en: After arriving in China, he also learned taijiquan.

items.py: Tā huà de huàr yě búcuò.
items.en: His paintings are also quite good.

items.zh: 可是他也有一个不好的爱好，那就是抽烟。
items.py: Kěshì tā yě yǒu yī gè bù hǎo de àihào, nà jiù shì chōu yān.
items.en: But he also has a bad hobby — smoking.

items.zh: 现在他身体不太好，要是不抽烟，他的身体一定比现在好。
items.py: Xiànzài tā shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, yàoshi bù chōu yān, tā de shēntǐ yīdìng bǐ xiànzài hǎo.
items.en: His health isn't great now. If he stopped smoking, he'd definitely be healthier.
